# Pennine Care Centre

> Pennine Care Centre is a premium residential care home in Glossop, Derbyshire, UK, on the edge of the Peak District. It provides residential, dementia, male-only, rehabilitation, and end-of-life care, regulated and inspected by the Care Quality Commission (CQC).

Pennine Care Centre is a purpose-built residential care home offering two distinct accommodation units — the Pennine Suite and the Moorland Suite (a male-only unit) — supported by 24-hour, person-centred care. The home emphasises dignity, independence, family involvement, and a full programme of activities alongside clinical and rehabilitative support.

## Care & Accommodation

- [Pennine Suite](https://penninecarecentre.com/pennine-suite): Fully secured, modern residential accommodation with private en-suite rooms, communal lounges/dining areas, and tranquil gardens.
- [Moorland Suite](https://penninecarecentre.com/moorland-suite): A dedicated male-only unit with private bedrooms, secure gardens, and specialist support.
- [Care Services](https://penninecarecentre.com/services): Older People Care, Dementia Care, Male Only Unit, Rehabilitation, and End of Life Care.
- [Life at Pennine](https://penninecarecentre.com/life-at-pennine): Daily life, in-house activities, community engagement, nutrition, person-centred care, and family partnerships.
